description: Get a historical time series of NBP rates for one currency against PLN: either the last N published quotes (last_n, default 30, max 255) or an explicit start_date/end_date window (max 93 days per query — NBP's hard limit; chain calls for longer spans). Quotes exist only for publication days: business days for tables 'a'/'c', Wednesdays for 'b'. Data starts 2002-01-02.

code.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, CHF). Case-insensitive.

end_date.description: Window end (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Requires start_date; span ≤ 93 days.

last_n.description: Return the last N published quotes (1-255). Default 30. Mutually exclusive with start_date/end_date.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh NBP fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

table.description: NBP table: 'a' (default) = official mid rates of ~35 major currencies, published every business day; 'b' = mid rates of ~115 less-traded currencies, published Wednesdays; 'c' = bid/ask (buy/sell) rates of major currencies, published every business day.

name: nbp_rate_series
title: NBP currency rate history
